mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.department_id, dep.name AS department, d.title, d.introduction FROM doctor d INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id WHERE d.id = #{doctorId} AND d.status = '启用'

SELECT d.id AS doctor_id, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.role, d.name, d.department_id, dep.name AS department_name, d.title, d.introduction, u.status, d.status AS doctor_status FROM doctor d INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.user_id INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId}
